archetypeVariants.designRationale: The coastal-resort archetype uses ocean blue tones with sand and terracotta accents. The bg-gradient-to-t from-brand-primary/70 to-transparent creates a beach-to-sky gradient effect. Text-text-primary provides readability on the lighter coastal background. The min-h-hero-lg height emphasizes spaciousness and horizontal airy layout. The before:gradient overlay mimics ocean depth with the gradient-to-t pattern.

The coastal-resort navigation uses transparent style for beach integration with backdrop-blur-md for readability. The h-nav-classic height provides standard navigation. The text-text-inverted ensures visibility on transparent backgrounds. The border-b border-border-default adds subtle definition.

The heritage-opulence gallery uses grid layout with generous gap-gap-section spacing for formal presentation. The card style uses elevated shadows with border-brand-secondary/subtle for refined elegance. The aspect-[4/3] landscape aspect ratio and md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 responsive columns provide structured, gallery-like presentation appropriate for luxury heritage properties.

The heritage-opulence archetype demands deep navy and burgundy tones with gold accents, expressing luxury and tradition. The class choices use bg-brand-primary gradient for the rich brand color, text-text-inverted for contrast on dark backgrounds, generous spacing with gap-hero, and grid layout for formal two-column presentation. The before:absolute overlay with bg-brand-primary/60 adds depth and sophistication appropriate for luxury heritage properties.

For heritage-opulence navigation, the solid background provides formal presence with border-b for structural definition. The h-20 height matches the classic navigation height for traditional luxury properties. Text-text-primary ensures readability while text-text-inverted can be used for accent elements.

The urban-tech gallery uses tight spacing with gap-2 md:gap-3 for efficient space usage. The card style is flat with border-border-default for clean tech-forward presentation. The aspect-square ratio and md:grid-cols-3 columns provide grid-based layout. Minimal shadow and border styling reflect the modern, functional aesthetic of tech-forward properties.

The urban-tech archetype requires bold primary colors on dark backgrounds with geometric sans typography and tight spacing. Using bg-brand-primary for maximum contrast, text-text-inverted for readability, rounded-lg corners for modern aesthetic, and tight spacing with gap-2 md:gap-3 reflects the efficient tech-forward design. The min-h-hero-md provides standard hero height without excess vertical space.
